title: [GMCP 203.017.03] Integration: Complete MCP client and host
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-017-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: GMCP is a full host, not only a tool caller: one API and CLI can connect to any supported server, discover capabilities, call tools, read and subscribe to resources, get prompts and completions, handle MRTR callbacks, tasks, Apps, authorization, notifications, progress and cancellation. Multiple servers operate concurrently with isolated identities, policies and state, and every callback surface is exercised against real reference servers. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Integration stage (`GMCP-203-017-03`) wires `susi mcp` CLI host commands through registered `mcp_config.json` HTTP and stdio servers under `MacPolicy` (`authorize_mcp_transport` + `spawn_authorized_stdio_peer`), adds Mandate 35 unknown-field retention and `McpHost::resume_persisted_task` / `update_task` crash-restart migration, and verifies parity across direct, SDK, daemon HTTP, gateway, and CLI entry points; adversarial, interop, operations, and `.M` mastery ship across `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-117..120`.

Per `docs/gmcp/contract-203-017.md` and zero-UI plan A9, Core ships headless MCP host protocol integration while interactive Apps viewports live in Susi Commercial Apps, and `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-017.jsonl` plus `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-017.json` remain strictly absent until `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-120` (`.M` Mastery).

reuse.why: Wired `susi mcp` host subcommands through `McpHost`, `GmcpClient` `mcp_config.json`, and `authorize_mcp_transport` / `spawn_authorized_stdio_peer`, and added `McpHost::resume_persisted_task` + Mandate 35 `PersistedTaskHandle.extra` preservation without adding workspace or external dependencies.
